text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school Certificate of HSK (Not need for English taught programs) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Permission from the previous university for tranfer students (Not need for English taught programs) A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university. 7.Guardian’s Guarantee (Not need for English taught programs) For applicant under 18 years of age.
